scope: Sauropod-focused comparative paleobiology; other dinosaur clades serve as controls rather than interchangeable examples.
validated_problem: Test whether a joint constraint-release model of feeding architecture, pneumaticity, growth/life history, and ecological opportunity predicts repeated sauropod gigantism better than single-factor explanations.
invariants: Every candidate idea must retain uncertainty in fossil mass, trait coding, and phylogeny.
Every causal claim must distinguish direct observation, proxy inference, and model output.
No idea may equate a large body with a high metabolic rate, tree-top browsing, or an observed thermal state.
The selected direction must provide a falsifiable prediction beyond retrospective narrative fit.
idea_prompt: Generate and compare research directions that turn the sauropod evolutionary cascade into a preregistered, fossil-anchored causal and predictive test.
